criteria.text: Signing up with an email already in use returns the error "email taken" and creates no second account.
Emails are compared case-insensitively at signup and at login.
After 5 failed logins within 15 minutes the account is locked for 30 minutes.
A locked account cannot log in even with the correct password.
A password reset token expires after 1 hour.
A reset token can be used only once.
Changing the password ends all other active sessions of the user but keeps the current one.
Admins can unlock a locked account; non-admins get PermissionDenied.
Sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity.

T03.name: test_unknown_email_gets_no_token
T03.code:
def test_unknown_email_gets_no_token(resets, ann):
    token = resets.request("nobody@example.com")

    assert token is None
    assert resets.tokens == {}

    real = resets.request(ANN_EMAIL)

    assert real is not None
    assert resets.tokens[real].user_id == ann.id

T04.name: test_duplicate_email_any_case
T04.code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "variant",
    [
        "Ann@example.com",
        "ANN@EXAMPLE.COM",
        "ann@Example.Com",
        "aNN@eXample.com",
        " ann@example.com ",
    ],
)
def test_duplicate_email_any_case(signups, ann, variant):
    result = signups.signup(variant, "another-pass-2")

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.error == "email taken"

T06.name: test_signup_creates_user
T06.code:
def test_signup_creates_user(signups, store, clock):
    clock.advance(minutes=30)

    result = signups.signup(
        "carol@example.com",
        "carol-pass-42",
        name="Carol Diaz",
    )

    assert result.ok is True
    assert result.error is None
    assert store.get(result.user.id) is result.user
    assert result.user.email == "carol@example.com"
    assert result.user.created_at == clock.now()

T07.name: test_failed_login_is_counted
T07.code:
def test_failed_login_is_counted(auth, clock, ann):
    started = clock.now()

    auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, WRONG)
    clock.advance(minutes=2)
    auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, WRONG)

    assert len(ann.failures) == 2
    assert ann.failures[0] == started
    assert ann.failures[-1] == clock.now()

T08.name: test_tampered_hash_fails
T08.code:
def test_tampered_hash_fails(ann):
    salt, _, digest = ann.password_hash.partition("$")
    tampered = f"{salt}${digest[:-1]}0" if digest[-1] != "0" else f"{salt}${digest[:-1]}1"

    assert not verify_password(PASSWORD, tampered)
    assert verify_password(PASSWORD, ann.password_hash)

T13.name: test_advance_minutes_and_hours
T13.code:
def test_advance_minutes_and_hours(clock):
    clock.advance(minutes=45)
    clock.advance(hours=2)

    assert clock.now() == datetime(2026, 3, 2, 11, 45, 0)

    returned = clock.advance(days=2, seconds=30)

    assert returned == clock.now()
    assert clock.now() == datetime(2026, 3, 4, 11, 45, 30)

def test_invalid_token_rejected(resets, ann):

T16.name: test_logout_ends_session
T16.code:
def test_logout_ends_session(auth, sessions, ann):
    session = auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, PASSWORD).session

    other = auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, PASSWORD).session

    auth.logout(session.token)

    assert not sessions.is_active(session.token)
    assert sessions.get(session.token).revoked is True
    assert sessions.is_active(other.token)

T17.name: test_password_change_revokes_sessions
T17.code:
def test_password_change_revokes_sessions(auth, sessions, ann):
    # Ann is signed in on three devices and changes her password on the first
    current = auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, PASSWORD).session
    laptop = auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, PASSWORD).session
    phone = auth.login(ANN_EMAIL, PASSWORD).session

    auth.change_password(ann, PASSWORD, NEW_PASSWORD, current_token=current.token)

    assert not sessions.is_active(laptop.token)
    assert not sessions.is_active(phone.token)

def test_login_returns_active_session(auth, sessions, ann):

def test_get_returns_the_session(self, sessions, ann, bob):
    first = sessions.create(ann.id)
    second = sessions.create(bob.id)

    assert sessions.get(first.token) is first
    assert sessions.get(second.token) is second
    assert sessions.get(first.token).user_id == ann.id
